parent.outcomes: Bounded 2-input Boolean LUT learner and equally trained controls 32/32 original toy holdouts; carry out-of-skeleton negative. No actual original science success.

question: Can cross-task supervision induce reusable causal expression motifs that materially participate in constructing new unseen compositions, rather than merely selecting a supplied fixed 2-input truth table? Test on role-binding full autoregressive trajectories.

synthetic_source_design.meta_task_examples: meta tasks supply complete causal FIT episodes; only allowed role-blind public trajectory labels
synthetic_source_design.heldout_task_roster: 2 heldout structural families × four seeds; per task 24 FIT +8 CHECK veto-only +8 full heldout 8-event episodes and 8 matched hard negatives
synthetic_source_design.task_creator_private_templates: 12 training tasks (six instances of ADD(own_current,source_current), six XOR(own_lag,event) with randomized init/event/role schedules). 8 unseen tasks compose two learned subexpressions using previously untrained TOP-level add/xor and reverse operand placement. Source-specific actual operator identities/tags remain hidden from model.

operator_vocabulary_and_learning.generic_common_primitives: all models provided only leaf nibbles, 4-bit modular addition, XOR, AND, rotate-left-1 and a bounded two-level expression-assembly procedure; no heldout composition template or correct operator selected
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.candidate: Induce reusable subexpression programs on 12 independent meta-training tasks using public labels; freeze learned library before any heldout FIT; construct 2-motif programs using generic top-level binary operation and fit by 24 FIT sequences, then CHECK veto.
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.ablation: Remove learned library while preserving 24 FIT, exact inference budget and fallback candidate family; record whether constructed unseen source-structure becomes unrepresentable. Ablation demonstrates learned motifs alter produced programs, not superiority over equally trained peer.
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.equal_meta_trained_peer: separately implemented learner with same complete meta-task data, same primitive vocabulary, same library size and top-level constructor budget; independent exhaustive enumeration and full FIT, not weaker/untrained
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.strong_direct_control: independently trained fully source-neutral original 211-term quadratic model and frozen 8D×45epoch gated recurrent control use same 24 FIT/8 CHECK
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.constructor_budget: Bounded macro library at most 12 canonical programs, binary top-level operations ADD/XOR/AND; all ordered pairs searched, no CHECK/heldout-driven model selection.
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.natural_admission: FIT must exactly match each of 192 teacher-input events; CHECK 8/8 full autoregressive episodes exact; only then heldout eight positive and eight matched hard-negative trajectories count; zero hard false positives.
operator_vocabulary_and_learning.resources: five independent complete Linux process repeats per heldout family/seed/arm if tractable; report actual per-process CPU/RSS and equal-work limitations.

critical_scope: This is source-free synthetic hierarchical composition, with shared primitive vocabulary and generic assembly grammar. Even perfect heldout is bounded to that grammar, not unrestricted invention of primitives nor independently replicated first-use transfer.
